caption: Comment “BUILD” for me FREE guide on building and scaling a mobile app in 2026
author: Steven | Building Viral Apps
transcript: This is exactly what it looks like to build a mobile app in 2026. And in the next 60 seconds, I'm going to explain why. I built four apps and my first app hit 45k per month before I sold the business. And my latest app is now doing over 150k per month. All bootstrapped, no investors, and no paid ads to start out. Just hustle, baby. Once the app is built and live on the store, all you have to do is market it. It'll drive you organic installs, recurring revenue, passive income, and there's not much day-to-day work needed to maintain the app itself. So here's how to build a successful mobile app. First, you need an idea, but not just any idea. You need an idea that solves a painful problem for a large number of people. And you also need to validate that idea. So go over to Sensor Tower and look at other apps in your niche. If there are other apps in your niche making money, then that means the market is proven. Then go to Google Trends, type in the keywords related to your app, and make sure people are actually searching for this stuff. If both boxes are checked, then that is your validation to build. Then you build the MVP fast with a tool like Rourke, and then you go to Upwork to hire a developer on the low to finalize the app. One feature, one problem. Keep it simple. One of the most important parts is getting your paywall right. You can A-B test your paywall with Superwall. You're going to A-B test your pricing and offer. This alone took me from 3k to 40k in monthly recurring revenue. And then once it's built, you simply market it. Post every single day, get content in mass from creators on posted, and then scale the winning organic videos on paid ads. Comment the word build and I'll send you my full guide on building and scaling mobile apps.
title: Build a $150K/Month Mobile App Blueprint
one_liner: A bootstrapped app founder shares his step-by-step system for building and scaling profitable mobile apps.
key_points: Validate your app idea using Sensor Tower (competitor revenue) and Google Trends (search demand) before building
Build an MVP fast with no-code tools like Rourke, then hire a dev on Upwork to finalize — one feature, one problem
Optimize your paywall using A/B testing with Superwall; this alone scaled one app from $3K to $40K MRR
Market by posting daily, source content from creators via Posted, then scale winning organic videos with paid ads
